item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"feature_construction","rationale":"Across all four datasets, replace tanh frequency scaling with bounded z/sqrt(1+z*z) scaling using the same standardized log1p training counts. Existing checkpoint buffers preserve these scales for prediction; padding and mask scales remain 1. Embeddings, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"    input_scales = 1.0 + 0.02 * np.tanh(standardized_counts)","replace":"    input_scales = 1.0 + 0.02 * standardized_counts / np.sqrt(1.0 + np.square(standardized_counts))"}]}],"change_summary":"Change only the training-frequency feature’s saturation function for each category’s single BERT4Rec model; existing checkpoint and predictor plumbing remains compatible."}
